title: 第17章 今天让你尝尝有咸味的肉-《全民饥荒：SSS级天赋酿酒师》
content:
第(1/3)页

    正午时分，两人灰头土脸地折返庇护所。

    壁炉里重新燃起火光，方芸用匕首将兔肉剃下来，架在火上干烤。

    许默则蹲在一旁，手里比划着几根纤维草和细树枝。

    工作台确实能通过图纸一键生成道具，没有图纸的无法制作。

    但系统并没有锁死玩家的动手能力。

    只要懂得原理，完全可以靠手搓，做出那些不在图纸列表里的物件。

    手指翻飞间，一个粗糙却结构精巧的简易捕鸟笼初具雏形。

    方芸撕下一小条烤得干柴的兔肉塞进嘴里，含糊不清地咀嚼。

    “你这手艺绝了，就是不知道这种捕鸟笼好不好用。”

    “我在想，既然你天赋这么变态，为什么不大批量酿酒挂到交易行？绝对能把那些人的幸存点榨干。”

    许默轻笑一声，直接调出自己所在频道的交易面板，将光幕推到方芸面前。

    满屏的猩红字体犹如催命符。

    【10单位木材！换100毫升能喝的水！求求了！】

    【15单位石材换水！脏水也行！我快渴死了！】

    方芸脸上的轻松瞬间凝固。

    许默屈起手指敲了敲光幕边缘。

    “看懂了吗？酿酒的必需品是水。”

    “我这个鬼区，水比命贵。你出生这个地方，也是根本没水，全区的水资源都涨价涨飞边了，如果不是我手里存着几瓶酒，咱们俩现在的干渴值早就红温了。”

    残酷现实当头浇下。

    许默拎起编好的捕鸟笼，在庇护所外找了个隐蔽的角落架好，撒下几粒不知名的草籽。

    方芸也手脚麻利地将剩余的狼肉全部剃下，挂在壁炉旁烘干。

    两人对视一眼，默契地抓起工具，直奔蜂后标记的密林。

    林子里的光线阴暗得可怕，两人不得不始终小心翼翼。

    在接近标记点的地方，一棵庞大到夸张的枯树映入眼帘。

    粗壮如蟒蛇般的黑色树根死死缠绕着什么东西，隐约透出金属的冷光。

    一阶普通宝箱！

    许默没有废话，抡起石斧对着干瘪的树根狠狠劈下。

    木屑崩飞，连续十几斧子下去，枯根终于不堪重负地断裂开来。

    方芸一脚踹开宝箱，伴随着一阵微弱的白光，两件物品静静地躺在箱底。

    一张羊皮纸，以及一小袋白色结晶。

    【初始农田图纸：建筑】

    【等阶：一阶（白色）】

    【建造材料：肥料X10，木材X5，土壤X5，空置领土】

    【建造时间：8小时】
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

At noon, the two men returned to the shelter in disgrace.

The fire rekindled in the fireplace, Fang Yun used a dagger to shave off the rabbit meat and put it on the fire to dry roast.

Xu Mo squatted aside, gesturing with a few fiber grasses and twigs in his hand.

The workbench can indeed generate props with one click through drawings, and it cannot be produced without drawings.

But the system does not lock the player’s hands-on ability.

As long as you understand the principles, you can completely make objects that are not in the drawing list by hand.

With a flick of the fingers, a simple birdcage with rough but exquisite structure began to take shape.

Fang Yun tore off a small strip of roasted rabbit meat and stuffed it into her mouth, chewing vaguely.

"You are very good at your craftsmanship, but I don't know if this kind of birdcage is easy to use."

"I was thinking, since your talent is so abnormal, why don't you make large quantities of wine and list it in the trading house? You can definitely drain those people of their survival points."

Xu Mo chuckled, directly called up the trading panel of his channel, and pushed the light screen in front of Fang Yun.

The scarlet font that fills the screen is like a reminder.

【10 units of wood!Replace it with 100ml of drinkable water!Please!】

【15 units of stone change water!Dirty water works too!I'm dying of thirst!】

The relief on Fang Yun’s face solidified instantly.

Xu Mo raised his fingers and tapped the edge of the light curtain.

"Do you understand? The necessity for making wine is water."

"In this ghost town of mine, water is more valuable than life. The place where you were born has no water at all. The price of water resources in the whole district has skyrocketed. If I hadn't kept a few bottles of wine in my hand, our thirst level would have been red."

The cruel reality fell upon us.

Xu Mo picked up the birdcage he had made, found a hidden corner outside the shelter, set it up, and scattered a few unknown grass seeds.

Fang Yun also quickly shaved off all the remaining wolf meat and hung it by the fireplace to dry.

The two looked at each other, grabbed the tools in tacit understanding, and headed straight to the dense forest marked by the queen bee.

The light in the forest was so dark that the two of them had to be cautious.

Near the marked point, an exaggeratedly huge dead tree came into view.

The black tree roots as thick as a python are tightly wrapped around something, and there is a faint metallic cold light.

A first-level ordinary treasure chest!

Xu Mo didn’t talk nonsense. He picked up the stone ax and struck hard at the withered tree root.

The wood chips flew away, and after more than a dozen ax strikes, the dead roots finally broke under the load.

Fang Yun kicked open the treasure box, and with a burst of faint white light, two items lay quietly at the bottom of the box.

A piece of parchment paper and a small bag of white crystals.

【Initial farmland drawings: buildings】

【Level: First level (white)】

【Construction materials: Fertilizer x10, wood x5, soil x5, vacant territory】

【Construction time: 8 hours】
